name: Knebworth Park Adventure Playground
description: Adventure playground and dinosaur trail in Knebworth Park, open 10.30am–5pm (last tickets 4.15pm) on set days from late March to September: weekends in spring and September, daily in the school holidays. Historic Houses members get in free on non-event days.
fee: Paid entry for non-members; members pay park entry on event days
notConfirmed: Next season's exact dates (check Knebworth's own website), equipment, toilets and café.
